info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Estimates-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Estimates API provides a streamlined method for users to access and retrieve detailed estimates related to insurance claims. Businesses, insurance adjusters, and claimants can utilize this API to obtain accurate cost estimates based on submitted claims, enhancing transparency and decision-making. By leveraging this endpoint, users can efficiently evaluate potential payouts and better understand their insurance claims' financial implications. It serves as a valuable resource for streamlining the claims process and ensuring all stakeholders have access to essential estimates.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch an estimate for a particular insurance claim. It provides detailed information on the potential payout based on the claim details submitted.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to estimate claims based on the provided input parameters. Please ensure that all required fields are accurately populated to receive an appropriate estimate.

200.description: The request was successful and the estimated claim details are returned.
